english: Sherbiv stood on the Rostavytsia in the lands southwest of Kyiv. A village of that name is recorded in 1471 and was badly damaged after the campaign of the Crimean khan Mengli Giray. In the late sixteenth century it came into the possession of the princely Ruzhynski family and was renamed Ruzhyn. The inhabitants of the district later took part in the Cossack and peasant uprisings that swept across right-bank Ukraine.
simp_chinese: 舍尔比夫位于基辅西南方的罗斯塔维齐亚河畔。同名村庄见于1471年的记载，克里米亚汗门利·格来出兵后，此地遭到严重破坏。十六世纪末，它归鲁任斯基公爵家族所有，并改名为鲁任。后来当地居民参加了席卷右岸乌克兰的哥萨克与农民起义。

english: The Sherbro coast is a world of islands, estuaries and channels on the Atlantic shore of Sierra Leone. English traders sought camwood here from the seventeenth century, and the Royal African Company established a post on York Island in 1688. Some foreign merchants married into influential Sherbro families; their descendants became intermediaries between African communities and overseas traders. In the eighteenth century these lineages played a prominent part in the trade that sent captive Africans across the ocean.
simp_chinese: 歇尔布罗海岸位于塞拉利昂的大西洋岸，是岛屿、河口和水道交织的世界。十七世纪起，英国商人在此寻购染料木，皇家非洲公司于1688年在约克岛建立商站。一些外国商人与有影响力的歇尔布罗家族通婚，后裔成为非洲社群与海外商人之间的中间人。十八世纪，这些家族在将被俘非洲人运过大洋的贸易中扮演了显著角色。

english: Sherbro Island lies off the coast of Sierra Leone, separated from the mainland by tidal waterways. Its low shores and mangroves belong to the homeland of the Sherbro, or southern Bullom, people. The island and neighbouring coast were drawn into Atlantic trade through alliances between local families and European merchants. Among them was the Caulker family, descended from the English trader Thomas Corker and a Sherbro woman; its members became prominent rulers and slave traders in the Sherbro country.
simp_chinese: 谢尔布罗岛位于塞拉利昂海岸外，潮汐水道将它与大陆隔开。低平的海岸与红树林属于谢尔布罗人，也称南布隆人的家园。当地家族与欧洲商人结成联盟，使岛屿和邻近海岸卷入大西洋贸易。其中的考尔克家族源自英国商人托马斯·科克与一位谢尔布罗女子，其后代成为谢尔布罗地区有势力的统治者和奴隶商人。

sources.title: Slaves,Slave Owners and Slave Dealers Sherbro Coast and Hinterland.htm

english: Sherda lies near the southwestern edge of the Tibesti, among the dry valleys that descend from the mountains toward Borkou. Along these wadis, Toubou communities cultivate palms and a little grain where water remains beneath the valley floor. The pastures of the highlands offer grazing at different seasons, while the oasis settlements of Sherda and nearby Zouar form part of a region of scattered communities amid the central Sahara.
simp_chinese: 谢尔达位于提贝斯提高山西南缘，附近的干河谷从山地向博尔库延伸。图布人在河谷中利用地下水种植枣椰和少量谷物，高地牧场则在不同季节供牲畜吃草。谢尔达与附近的祖阿尔等聚落散布在这片山地之中，在撒哈拉腹地形成一个个绿洲家园。

english: Shergarh lies in the hills of the Chota Nagpur plateau near Giridih. To the southwest rises Parasnath, a sacred mountain known to Jains as Sammed Shikhar. Jain tradition holds that twenty of the twenty-four Tirthankaras attained liberation here. Temples and shrines crown the hill, which is also revered by the Santal as Marang Buru.
simp_chinese: 谢尔格尔位于乔塔那格浦尔高原的丘陵中，靠近吉里迪。西南方耸立着帕拉斯纳特山，耆那教徒称其为萨梅德希哈尔。依耆那教传统，二十四位祖师中有二十位在此获得解脱；山上有寺庙与圣祠，桑塔尔人也以马朗布鲁之名敬奉此山。

english: Sherwan lies on a ridge in the wooded hills of Tanawal, west of the country of Abbottabad. The valley is enclosed by mountains, with the Mangal River flowing to the south. Tanawal formed part of Pakhli under Turkish rulers, and Sherwan was the seat of the governor of Lower Tanawal. Qias al-Din, the last of these Turkish governors, held office during the third quarter of the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 谢尔万位于塔纳瓦尔林木茂密的山脊上，在阿伯塔巴德地区以西。群山环绕河谷，芒加尔河从南面流过。塔纳瓦尔在突厥统治者治下属于帕赫利，谢尔万是下塔纳瓦尔总督的驻地。最后一位突厥总督基亚斯丁于十八世纪第三个二十五年间在任。

english:
Sheshatshiu stands by the narrow waterway between Grand Lake and Lake Melville, at the eastern end of a long Innu travel route into the Labrador interior. Innu families gathered here in summer after spending much of the year hunting caribou farther inland. Rivers and lakes led west towards Meshikamau, with portages and camps marking a journey followed by many generations.

In 1743 the French merchant Louis Fornel sent Jean Pilote and his son to establish a trading post at North West River, across the water from Sheshatshiu. Innu hunters brought furs to exchange for European goods, while continuing their seasonal journeys through Nitassinan. The gathering place connected the inland hunting country with the long inlet leading east to the Labrador coast.
simp_chinese:
谢沙秀位于大湖与梅尔维尔湖之间的狭窄水道旁，是一条深入拉布拉多内陆的因努行旅路线的东端。因努家庭一年中大部分时间在内陆猎取北美驯鹿，夏季则来到这里聚会。湖泊与河流向西通往梅希卡毛，沿途的搬舟路和营地见证了世代行旅。

1743年，法国商人路易·福内尔派让·皮洛特和他的儿子在隔水相望的西北河建立贸易站。因努猎人带来毛皮交换货物，同时继续在家园尼塔西南进行季节性迁徙。这处聚会地点连接着内陆猎场，以及通向拉布拉多海岸的漫长海湾。

english: Shestakova lies near the upper Ozhogina, south of the Alazeya Plateau. The river begins where the Sulakkan and Delkyu meet, their sources rising on the northern slopes of the Moma Range. Sparse larch taiga covers its winding valley.
simp_chinese: 舍斯塔科瓦靠近奥若吉纳河上游，位于阿拉泽亚高原以南。苏拉坎河与杰尔库河发源于莫马山脉北坡，汇合后形成奥若吉纳河；稀疏的落叶松泰加林覆盖着蜿蜒的河谷。

english: Lake Shetek lies among the prairies of southwestern Minnesota and forms the headwaters of the Des Moines River. Its name comes from the Ojibwe word for pelican, a bird that visits the lake in the warmer months. Large lakes are uncommon in the surrounding country, making this expanse of water a prominent feature of the prairie. From here the Des Moines flows south and east across Iowa before joining the Mississippi.
simp_chinese: 谢泰克湖位于明尼苏达西南部的草原之中，是得梅因河的源头。湖名来自奥吉布瓦语中的鹈鹕；天气温暖时，这种鸟会来到湖上。周围地区的大湖并不多见，这片水面因而成为草原上一处显眼的地标。得梅因河从这里向南、向东穿过艾奥瓦，最终汇入密西西比河。

english: Shethanei Lake lies at the meeting of the North and South Seal rivers, from which the Seal River continues east to Hudson Bay. Its Dene name refers to a hill; local accounts associate it with an esker standing beside the water, near an old Dene camping place. Samuel Hearne recorded a form of the name during his travels in the region. Even harbour seals from the bay can travel far inland along the river to the lake.
simp_chinese: 谢塔内湖位于北锡尔河与南锡尔河交汇之处，锡尔河从这里继续向东流入哈德孙湾。湖泊的德内语名称指一座山丘；当地说法将它与水边一条冰水堆积的砂砾脊相联系，附近曾是古老的德内人营地。塞缪尔·赫恩在此地旅行时记下了这一名称的一种形式。来自海湾的港海豹甚至能沿河深入内陆，抵达湖中。

english:
Shetland lies between the North Sea and the North Atlantic. Its communities combined fishing and seafaring with small-scale farming and livestock husbandry. Long governed under the Norwegian crown, the islands passed into Scottish control when they were pledged in 1469 as security for the dowry of Margaret of Denmark, who married James III of Scotland. Norse traditions persisted under Scottish rule, and the Norn language was still spoken in the eighteenth century.

From the fifteenth century German merchants traded with Shetlanders, buying fish and bringing goods from across the North Sea. Their trade diminished after the parliamentary union of Scotland and England in 1707, and Shetland merchants became more prominent as buyers and exporters. Lerwick grew around a harbour used by fishing fleets; the earliest surviving mention of the settlement dates from 1625. In the later eighteenth century, ships bound for the Greenland whale fishery also called at Shetland for supplies and crews. These maritime connections tied island households to distant markets while fishing and farming continued to sustain local life.
simp_chinese:
设得兰群岛位于北海与北大西洋之间，居民兼营捕鱼、航海、小规模耕作和畜牧。群岛长期归挪威王权统治，1469年被抵押给苏格兰，作为丹麦的玛格丽特嫁给苏格兰国王詹姆斯三世时嫁妆的担保。苏格兰统治之下，北欧传统并未立即消失，诺恩语到十八世纪仍有人使用。

从十五世纪起，德意志商人跨越北海到设得兰购买鱼货并带来其他商品。1707年苏格兰与英格兰议会合并后，这种贸易逐渐减少，设得兰商人作为鱼货买家和出口商的作用日益突出。勒威克围绕渔船使用的港口发展，现存文献最早于1625年提到这一聚落。十八世纪后期，前往格陵兰捕鲸的船只也在设得兰补给和招募船员。这些海上联系把岛民与远方市场连接起来，而渔业与农业仍是当地生活的基础。

english: Sheu’l’ec is a name associated with northern groups of the Qom, or Toba, people of the Gran Chaco. Qom communities speak a Guaycuruan language and traditionally inhabited a broad region of forest, grassland and wetlands. Hunting, fishing and gathering supplied food as people moved through their territories. The Pilcomayo and Bermejo rivers cross this lowland country, with seasonal floods changing the extent of the wetlands.
simp_chinese: 谢乌莱克是大查科科姆人北部群体的名称；科姆人也称托巴人。科姆社群使用瓜伊库鲁语族语言，传统上居住在森林、草地和湿地交错的广阔地区。人们在领地内迁徙，通过狩猎、捕鱼和采集获取食物。皮尔科马约河与贝尔梅霍河穿过这片低地，季节性洪水改变着湿地的范围。

english:
She County was the seat of Huizhou, set among the mountains of southern Anhui on the Xin'an River. Its merchants travelled widely, while wealth returned to build halls, houses and carved stone gateways. The town was also a centre of ink making, a craft closely tied to the writing and painting prized by its scholars.

Huizhou ink drew on techniques associated with the master Li Tinggui and was made in numerous workshops in She. By the Ming, it reached buyers in Japan and Southeast Asia as well as markets within China. In 1584 a stone archway was erected in the county town for Xu Guo, a native son who had risen to the Grand Secretariat. Its eight pillars made it a conspicuous monument to the standing of a Huizhou scholar at court.
simp_chinese:
歙县是徽州府治，坐落在皖南群山中的新安江畔。徽商远行四方，带回的财富修建厅堂、宅院和雕刻精美的石坊。这里也是制墨中心，墨与士人珍视的书画紧密相连。

歙县墨工承袭李廷珪一脉的技艺，众多作坊制作徽墨。明代产品除销往国内，还远达日本和东南亚。1584年，县城为入阁的本地士人许国立起石坊，八根石柱支撑的牌楼彰显了这位徽州人在朝廷中的地位。

english: Shexian lies in the Taihang Mountains, west of the North China Plain. On a nearby mountainside stands Wahuang Palace, a sanctuary dedicated to Nüwa, the goddess said to have made humanity and repaired the sky. Its cliffs also bear Buddhist scriptures carved under the Northern Qi. In the Ming and Qing, local patrons repaired the sanctuary and recorded their gifts on stone tablets, preserving a flourishing tradition of worship.
simp_chinese: 涉县位于华北平原以西的太行山中。附近山腰上的娲皇宫供奉女娲，相传她造人并炼石补天；崖壁上还留有北齐刻写的佛经。明清时期，地方信众捐资修缮宫庙，并在碑刻上记录捐献，延续了兴盛的祭祀传统。

english: Shey was an early royal centre of Ladakh, overlooking the Indus valley near Leh. Its palace rose on a hill above the settlement, and its royal monastery houses a great image of Shakyamuni Buddha. The hilltop palace became a model for later royal building in Leh and Tsaparang. During the sixteenth-century invasion of Ladakh, the Moghul commander Mirza Haidar Dughlat stayed at Shey. In 1655 King Deldan Namgyal ordered a later palace and monastery built below the older royal residence in memory of his father, Sengge Namgyal. The monumental Buddha image made for the monastery joined the royal family with the religious traditions they patronised in Ladakh.
simp_chinese: 谢伊是拉达克早期的王室中心，位于列城附近，俯瞰印度河谷。宫殿高踞聚落上方的山丘，王室寺院内供奉着巨大的释迦牟尼佛像。山顶宫殿后来成为列城与札布让王室建筑效仿的范例。十六世纪莫卧儿将领米尔扎·海达尔·杜格拉特入侵拉达克时，曾在谢伊停留。1655年，德勒丹南杰国王为纪念父亲森格南杰，下令在旧王宫下方兴建新的宫殿和寺院。寺中巨大的佛像，将王室与其所资助的拉达克佛教传统联系在一起。

english: The Shiawassee flows north through the interior of Michigan's lower peninsula. After a course of roughly 110 miles, it meets the Tittabawassee to form the Saginaw River, whose waters reach Lake Huron through Saginaw Bay. Its name comes from an Ojibwe expression referring to a river running straight ahead and sparkling, a striking description of the waterway.
simp_chinese: 希亚瓦西河向北流过密歇根下半岛内陆，行程约一百一十英里后与蒂塔巴瓦西河汇合，形成萨吉诺河。河水经萨吉诺湾注入休伦湖。其名称来自奥吉布瓦语，形容河流向前伸展、水面闪耀，是对这条水道生动的描绘。

english:
Shibam rises above Wadi Hadramawt as a dense cluster of tall mudbrick houses enclosed by a fortified wall. Some of these houses reach seven storeys, their narrow streets and squares arranged within a compact plan. Palm groves and fields surround the town, watered by the seasonal floods of the wadi. Its position made it a stopping place for caravans crossing the southern Arabian plateau.

The settlement has roots in pre-Islamic times, and its Friday mosque and fortress preserve much older traditions than the tower houses. In 1532–33 a great flood destroyed part of the earlier town. Shibam was rebuilt on raised ground, its closely packed houses rising within the walls. A dam upstream helped break the force of later floods. Thick walls of sun-dried brick, made from the earth of the valley, formed dwellings that combined the needs of family life with defence in a region contested by rival groups.

Shibam prospered in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries as Hadrami merchants travelled and traded abroad. The wealth and standing of its families found expression in their homes, whose height gave the city its striking silhouette above the floodplain. The surrounding fields, the flow of floodwater and the mud used for building tied the town's architecture closely to the valley that sustained it.
simp_chinese:
希巴姆高出哈德拉毛谷地，密集的高层泥砖住宅被设防城墙围住。其中一些住宅高达七层，狭窄街道和广场排列在紧凑的城市布局中。棕榈园与田地环绕城镇，由干河季节性洪水灌溉。这里也是商队穿越南阿拉伯高原的歇脚处。

聚落的根源可追溯至伊斯兰教以前，主麻清真寺和堡垒保留着比塔楼更古老的传统。1532至1533年，一场大洪水毁坏了早期城镇的一部分。希巴姆在较高地面重建，密集房屋在墙内向上伸展。上游的一座水坝帮助减弱后来洪水的力量。厚墙以谷地泥土制成的日晒砖建造，在各方竞争的地区兼顾家庭生活与防御。

十七至十八世纪，哈德拉毛商人在海外旅行贸易，希巴姆随之繁荣。家族的财富和地位体现在住宅上，楼房高度使城市在洪泛平原之上呈现醒目的轮廓。周围田地、洪水流动和用于建造的泥土，将城镇建筑与养育它的谷地紧密联系起来。

english: The eastern Red Sea coast is fringed by islands, coral reefs and shallow channels north of Yanbu. The reefs shelter a rich variety of marine life, while the dry Arabian coast and mountains rise beyond them. Boats approaching the shore must navigate around the coral and sandbanks. These waters lie along the route between the ports of the Hijaz and the northern Red Sea.
simp_chinese: 延布以北的红海东岸外缘分布岛屿、珊瑚礁和浅水道。礁石庇护多样海洋生物，干燥的阿拉伯海岸与山地则在后方升起。靠岸船只须绕过珊瑚和沙洲，这片水域位于汉志港口与红海北部之间的航路上，过往水手依靠对岛屿和水道的认识辨别航向。

english: Shibetoro lies at the northeastern end of Etorofu, among high volcanic mountains. The Shibetoro River flows north to the Sea of Okhotsk, forming a narrow strip of level ground along its course. Ainu communities lived along the island's shores and rivers, drawing food from the surrounding waters. At the beginning of the nineteenth century Japanese administration extended over Etorofu, bringing changes to the lives and customs of its inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 蕊取位于择捉岛东北端，高耸的火山群环绕其间。蕊取川向北流入鄂霍次克海，沿途形成狭窄的平地。阿伊努人居住在岛上的海岸与河流附近，从周围水域获取食物。十九世纪初，日本的行政管理扩及择捉，岛民的生活与习俗随之受到影响。

english: Shibetsu lies on the shore of the strait facing Kunashiri, in a district formerly known as Menashi. Salmon sustained its Ainu communities, whose trade reached beyond the coast. The name Shibetsu has been explained from Ainu words for a great river or a place rich in salmon. In the late eighteenth century Japanese merchants established fisheries here, and harsh treatment of Ainu workers helped provoke the Kunashiri-Menashi uprising of 1789. A road across the mountains to Shari was opened in 1810.
simp_chinese: 标津位于面向国后的海峡岸边，所在地区过去称为目梨。鲑鱼支撑着当地阿伊努人的生活，他们的贸易远及海岸之外。标津一名有“大河”或“鲑鱼众多之处”等阿伊努语解释。十八世纪后期，日本商人在此开设渔场，对阿伊努劳动者的苛待促成了一七八九年的国后、目梨起事。一八一〇年，越山通往斜里的道路开通。

english: Shibogama takes its name from a lake in the northern Ontario interior, part of a country of boreal forest, wetlands and interconnected waterways. The Oji-Cree communities of the region have long drawn food from its lakes and rivers, travelling between places used in different seasons. Waterways offered routes through a landscape in which stretches of land between navigable waters had to be crossed on foot.
simp_chinese: 希博加马得名于安大略北部内陆的一座湖泊，这里遍布北方森林、湿地和相互连接的水道。当地奥吉克里人长期从湖河中获取食物，在不同季节使用的地点之间往来。水路提供了穿越这片土地的通道，水域之间的陆地则需步行越过。

english: Shibushi Bay opens southeastward to the Pacific at the base of the Ōsumi Peninsula. A long sandy coast curves around its inner shore, backed by dunes and the broad volcanic plateaus of southern Kyūshū. Several rivers, including the Kimotsuki, cross the dunes to enter the bay. To seaward lies Birō Island, whose vegetation reflects the warmth of these southern waters.
simp_chinese: 志布志湾位于大隅半岛根部，向东南敞开，通往太平洋。漫长沙岸沿湾内弯曲延伸，背后是沙丘与九州南部广阔的火山台地。肝属川等数条河流穿过沙丘注入海湾，海中则有枇榔岛，岛上的植被体现了南方海域的温暖气候。

english: The Shichaam Lhavos are a downriver group of the Nivaclé people of the Gran Chaco. Together with the upriver Chishamnee they are known as people of the Pilcomayo River. The Nivaclé speak a Mataguayan language and traditionally inhabited the riverbanks and surrounding plains. Hunting, fishing, gathering and small-scale cultivation supported communities in a landscape of woodland and wetlands that changed with the river’s floods.
simp_chinese: 希查姆拉沃斯是大查科尼瓦克莱人的下游群体，与上游的奇沙姆内人同被称为皮尔科马约河人。尼瓦克莱人使用马塔瓜约语族语言，传统上生活在河岸和周围平原。狩猎、捕鱼、采集和小规模耕作维持社群生活；河流洪水不断改变林地与湿地交错的景观。

english: Shichah is a name for the Bad River, which crosses the plains of central South Dakota to join the Missouri. The river drains a broad area of rolling prairie west of the great river. On an early map the name Shichah appears alongside Bad River, reflecting the river’s Indigenous and English names. Its course approaches the Missouri from the west through a valley cut into the surrounding plains.
simp_chinese: 希查是巴德河的一个名称。这条河穿过南达科他中部平原，汇入密苏里河，汇集大河以西广大起伏草原的水流。一幅早期地图将希查与“坏河”并列，保留了河流的原住民名称与英文名称。它从西方接近密苏里河，河谷切入周围平原。

english: Shíchéng was a county in western Guangdong, west of Huàzhōu. In 1167 Song officials requested its re-establishment because the western part of neighbouring Wúchuān was populous and lay far from the seat of government. The new county was formed on the site of an older Shíchéng. Under the Ming it passed to Gāozhōu Prefecture in 1376, before returning to the jurisdiction of Huàzhōu in 1381. It retained the name Shíchéng throughout the Ming and Qing periods.
simp_chinese: 石城是广东西部化州以西的一处县治。南宋乾道三年（1167年），地方官员因吴川县西乡地广人多、远离治所，请求在旧石城之地重设县治。明洪武九年（1376年），石城县改属高州府，五年后又归化州管辖。明清时期，石城一直沿用这一县名。

english: Shicheng was an old county in the country west of the Luan River. Established under the Tang, it was later governed from Luanzhou. The Yuan incorporated the county into neighbouring Laoting, then transferred its land to Yifeng in 1266. Its changing boundaries belong to the history of a plain crossed by routes between the capital region and the northeast.
simp_chinese: 石城是滦河以西的旧县，唐代设置，后来归滦州管辖。元初石城县并入乐亭，至元三年（1266年）其地改属义丰。县境的变化，留下了这片连接京畿与东北平原的行政沿革。

english: Shicheng stands on the Qin River in the mountains of southeastern Jiangxi, on routes toward Fujian and Guangdong. The county was founded in 953, with its seat beside the river. To the southeast, the red cliffs and caves of Tongtianzhai rise above the valleys, their weathered surfaces cracked into striking patterns. Tea grew on the rocky heights; Malan tea from the mountain was sent as tribute during the Ming and Qing. An old Buddhist pagoda and city walls marked the county town below.
simp_chinese: 石城位于江西东南山地琴江之滨，通往福建、广东的道路经过附近。县于953年设立，治所临江。城东南通天寨赤色山崖与洞穴耸立，岩面风化龟裂，形态奇特。山上所产马兰茶在明清时期曾入贡；山下县城则有古塔与城墙。

english: Shida lies in the western part of Suruga, where the Tōkaidō crosses a broad plain. Tanaka Castle became a focus of fighting among the Imagawa, Takeda and Tokugawa during the sixteenth century. In the Edo period, Tanaka domain governed many of the surrounding villages, while Fujieda and Okabe prospered as post stations. Their inns served the travellers and official processions moving between Edo and Kyoto.
simp_chinese: 志太位于骏河西部，东海道穿过当地宽阔平原。十六世纪，田中城成为今川、武田与德川氏争夺的焦点。江户时代，田中藩统治周围许多村庄，藤枝和冈部则作为宿场兴盛，旅店接待往返江户与京都的旅人及官方行列。

english: Shidai lies in the mountains of southern Anhui, in the upper basin of the Qiupu River. Its name comes from three great stones in a stream that blocked the meeting waters like a weir and prevented boats from passing. The county was re-established under the Tang in 766 from parts of Qiupu, Qingyang and Jing. Its gazetteer describes the waterways and rapids of this rugged district, including the Seven Li River, which leads toward the main course of the Qiupu.
simp_chinese: 石埭位于皖南山地、秋浦河上游。地名源于溪中三块巨石：石头壅塞三水，形如堰埭，舟船不得通行。唐代于766年从秋浦、青阳、泾县划地复置石埭县。县志记载了山中水道与险滩，其中七里河通向秋浦大溪。

english: Shidian lies south of Yongchang in a basin surrounded by the hills of western Yunnan. Under the Yuan a native commandery was established here, and the name Shidian later came to be written with different characters. The Qing abolished the commandery in 1649 and created Pingyi Prefecture, moving its seat to a village by the stone bridge at Baochang. In 1770 a patrol office was established in the district under Yongchang Prefecture.
simp_chinese: 石甸位于永昌以南的盆地，周围群山环绕。元代在此设石甸长官司，明代地名改写为施甸。1649年，清朝撤长官司，设平彝州，将治所迁至保场大石桥边的村寨。1770年，又在施甸设巡政厅，隶属永昌府。

english: Shiewhibak, or Isleta Pueblo, is a Tiwa community on the Rio Grande south of the central New Mexican pueblos. Its fields draw on the river in a dry valley, and its position placed it along the route later known as El Camino Real. The pueblo’s history reflects both enduring Tiwa traditions and the movement of families among communities of the Southwest. During the Pueblo Revolt of 1680, Spanish colonists and Indigenous allies fled south along the river. Many Isleta people also went south, and descendants of Tiwa refugees returned to the pueblo in 1709 and 1718. Their return helped shape a community with varied cultural traditions.
simp_chinese: 希维巴克，即伊斯莱塔普韦布洛，是格兰德河畔的蒂瓦人社区，位于新墨西哥中部诸村以南。干旱河谷中的田地依靠河水，村落也处在后来称为“皇家大道”的路线沿途。它的历史既体现蒂瓦传统的延续，也体现西南各社区之间的家庭迁徙。1680年普韦布洛起义期间，西班牙殖民者及其原住民盟友沿河向南逃离。许多伊斯莱塔人也南迁；1709年和1718年，蒂瓦难民的后代返回村落，帮助形成了拥有多种文化传统的社区。

english: Shifang lies north of Chengdu, where the plain meets the foothills of the Longmen Mountains. Luohan Temple, founded in the Tang, was associated with the Chan master Mazu Daoyi, who entered monastic life there. Its religious buildings and images stood amid a county of irrigated fields; local gazetteers also recorded ceremonies at the opening of irrigation works, when communities gathered to pray for the coming agricultural season.
simp_chinese: 什邡位于成都以北，平原与龙门山麓在此相接。罗汉寺始建于唐代，禅宗大师马祖道一曾在此出家。寺院和造像坐落在灌溉田地之间；地方志还记载，每年开堰时居民聚集祭祀，为即将到来的农事季节祈福。

english:
Shigar lies along the river of the same name in Baltistan, north of Skardu. Its rulers, known as the Amacha, held one of the region's mountain principalities. Their fortified palace, Fong Khar, takes its name from the rock on which it stands; its carved timber displays influences from both Kashmir and Tibet. An older fort occupied the cliff above it.

In 1532 the army of the Yarkand ruler Abu Said Khan invaded Shigar on its way towards Kashmir. Later in the century the ruler Haydar Khan opened the Braldo pass and exchanged ambassadors with Yarkand. In the seventeenth century the Amacha ruler Hassan Khan recovered his throne with Mughal assistance and brought craftsmen from Kashmir to build the palace. Carpenters, stone carvers and other artisans helped give the fortress its richly decorated appearance.
simp_chinese:
希加尔位于巴尔蒂斯坦的同名河谷，处在斯卡都以北。当地的阿马恰家族统治着这一带的山地小国。其设防宫殿丰卡尔因建在岩石上而得名，木雕兼具克什米尔和西藏的艺术影响；更古老的堡垒则坐落在上方崖边。

1532年，叶尔羌统治者阿布·赛义德汗的军队入侵希加尔，继而前往克什米尔。本世纪稍后，统治者海达尔汗开通布拉尔多山口，并与叶尔羌互派使节。十七世纪，阿马恰家族的哈桑汗借助莫卧儿军队夺回王位，又从克什米尔引入匠人兴建宫堡。木匠、石雕匠等工匠共同塑造了宫堡装饰繁富的面貌。

english:
Shigatse is a principal town of Tsang, where the Nyang River meets the Yarlung Tsangpo. A fortress crowns the ridge above the settlement, while the great monastery of Tashilhunpo occupies its own extensive precinct. Founded in 1447 by Gendun Drup, later recognised as the First Dalai Lama, Tashilhunpo became an important centre of the Gelug tradition and the seat of the Panchen Lamas.

In 1435 the Rinpung family moved its administration from its ancestral fortress to Samdrubtse at Shigatse. From this base the family extended its power across Tsang and challenged the authorities of Ü. The later Tsangpa rulers also held court at Shigatse, until Güshi Khan's Mongol forces defeated them in 1642. The Fifth Dalai Lama was then enthroned at the fortress as ruler of Tibet. At Tashilhunpo, his teacher Lobsang Chökyi Gyaltsen became known as the Panchen Lama, establishing a religious lineage closely associated with the monastery.
simp_chinese:
日喀则是藏地的重要城镇，年楚河在此汇入雅鲁藏布江。宗堡高踞城镇上方的山脊，宏大的扎什伦布寺则自成一片寺院建筑群。1447年，后来被追认为一世达赖喇嘛的根敦珠巴创建此寺，使其成为格鲁派的重要中心和历世班禅喇嘛的驻锡地。

1435年，仁蚌家族将政务中心从祖传堡垒迁至日喀则的桑珠孜，并以此为基地扩展在藏地的势力，挑战卫地的权威。后来的藏巴政权也在日喀则设廷，直到1642年被固始汗的蒙古军队击败。随后五世达赖喇嘛在宗堡登位，成为西藏统治者。扎什伦布寺的洛桑却吉坚赞是他的老师，获称班禅喇嘛，开启了与这座寺院密切相关的宗教传承。

english:
Shughnan is a mountain country of the western Pamirs, centred on the valleys of the Gunt and Shakhdara and the banks of the Panj. Its people speak Shughni, one of the Eastern Iranian languages of the Pamirs. Narrow inhabited valleys lie between formidable ranges, while the Panj links the region with neighbouring Ishkashim and Rushan.

Shughnan was ruled by local princes whose fortunes shifted between independence and the influence of its larger neighbours. Rushan was often governed by relatives of its rulers, and in the eighteenth century became its vassal. Shughnan and Wakhan also struggled over Ishkashim, a district known for its ruby deposits. These small mountain realms maintained their own rulers amid the rivalries of Badakhshan, Darvaz and Bukhara.
simp_chinese:
舒格南是西帕米尔的山地地区，以贡特河、沙赫达拉河谷和喷赤河两岸为中心。当地人使用舒格南语，它属于帕米尔地区的东伊朗语支。狭窄的有人居住的河谷夹在险峻山岭之间，喷赤河则将这里与邻近的伊什卡希姆和鲁尚联系起来。

舒格南由地方王公统治，其地位在独立与受较大邻国影响之间变化。鲁尚常由其统治者的亲属管理，十八世纪成为舒格南的属地。舒格南与瓦罕也曾争夺以红宝石矿闻名的伊什卡希姆。这些小型山地政权在巴达赫尚、达尔瓦兹和布哈拉的角逐中保持了各自的统治者。

english: Shigony lies on the Usa, west of the great bend of the Volga. The district was known as Nogaisky Brod, or Nogai Ford, recalling the peoples who travelled through this part of the steppe. A Russian village called Shigony grew here in the early eighteenth century, on an estate held by Alexander Menshikov. The surrounding Usolye lands had earlier belonged to the Stroganov family and the Savvino-Storozhevsky Monastery.
simp_chinese: 希戈内位于乌萨河畔，地处伏尔加大河湾以西。此地旧称诺盖渡口，令人想起曾经穿行这片草原的人群。18世纪初，一座称为希戈内的俄罗斯村庄在亚历山大·缅希科夫的庄园中兴起。周围的乌索利耶土地此前曾属于斯特罗加诺夫家族和萨瓦－斯托罗热夫斯基修道院。

english: Lake Shijiu lies in the lowlands between the Yangtze and the Tai Lake basin. It is one of the lakes left as the ancient Danyang marsh silted up and separated into smaller waters. Streams from the mountains of southern Anhui enter the lake system, while channels carry water west toward the Yangtze. To the east, the Xu River cuts through the hills toward the Tai Lake basin; neighbouring Lake Gucheng forms another part of this network of rivers and lakes.
simp_chinese: 石臼湖位于长江与太湖流域之间的低地。古丹阳大泽逐渐淤积，分化为较小湖泊，石臼湖便是其中之一。皖南山地来水汇入湖区，再经河道向西流往长江；东面的胥河穿过丘陵，通向太湖流域。附近固城湖也是这一江湖水网的一部分。

english: Shikama is a harbour on the coast of Harima, at the mouth of the Noda River. Its name appears in the ancient poetry of the Man'yōshū, and its sheltered anchorage later became Himeji's gateway to the Inland Sea. In the Edo period, boats connected the port with Himeji Castle, while roads led inland toward the mines of Ikuno. Coastal merchant ships also called here, bringing Shikama into the lively exchange of the Inland Sea.
simp_chinese: 饰磨是播磨海岸野田川河口的港口，其名称见于古代诗集《万叶集》。这处避风港后来成为姬路通往濑户内海的门户。江户时代，船运将港口与姬路城相连，道路则通往内陆的生野矿山。沿海商船也在此停靠，使饰磨成为内海繁忙贸易网络的一部分。

english:
Shikarpur lies west of the Indus in upper Sindh, near routes leading through the Bolan Pass towards Afghanistan. Founded in the early seventeenth century, it grew into a major commercial and financial centre. Its merchants and bankers maintained networks reaching from the Indus valley to Central Asia, advancing money and moving goods along caravan routes. Covered bazaars gave shelter to the trade that made the town prosperous.

Shikarpur’s position brought it under several rulers in the eighteenth century, including the Afghan Durrani kings and the Talpurs of Sindh. Its commercial houses remained active across political frontiers, with agents travelling to places such as Bukhara while families and capital remained connected to Sindh. The town’s prosperity reflected its role as a meeting point between the river plain, the mountain passes and the markets beyond them.
simp_chinese:
希卡尔布尔位于上信德印度河以西，靠近穿越波兰山口通往阿富汗的道路。它建于十七世纪初，发展为重要商业和金融中心。商人与钱庄维持从印度河谷延伸至中亚的网络，为商队路线上的货物与资金往来提供支持。带顶棚的集市为使城镇繁荣的贸易提供庇护。

十八世纪，希卡尔布尔因地理位置先后归多位统治者掌管，包括阿富汗杜兰尼诸王与信德塔尔普尔人。商号继续跨越政治边界活动，代理人前往布哈拉等地，而家族与资本仍同信德相连。城镇的繁荣反映了它作为河流平原、山口与远方市场之间交汇点的作用。

sources.title: Sindh Through History and Rrpresentations French Contributions to Sindhi Studies Edited By Michel Boivin.pdf

english: Shikashin was a Nogai settlement remembered along the middle course of the Ural, a river once known as the Yaik. It appeared on late medieval maps and was mentioned by the eighteenth-century naturalist Peter Simon Pallas. Its precise site has since been lost; one tradition placed it near the mouth of the Kindel, a river whose course and junction with the Ural changed over time.
simp_chinese: 希卡申是乌拉尔河中游一处见于记载的诺盖人聚落，乌拉尔河过去称为雅伊克河。中世纪晚期的地图上标有此地，十八世纪博物学家彼得·西蒙·帕拉斯也曾提及。聚落的确切位置后来失传；一种说法将它置于金杰尔河口附近，而这条河的河道及与乌拉尔河的汇合处历来多有变化。

english: The Ilistaya rises on the northern slopes of the Przhevalsky Range, part of the Sikhote-Alin. It flows north-west out of the mountains and enters the southern end of Lake Khanka in two branches. On an eighteenth-century map made by Jesuit missionaries, the river was recorded under the Manchu name Lefu Bira.
simp_chinese: 伊利斯塔亚河发源于锡霍特山脉中普尔热瓦利斯基岭的北坡，向西北流出山地，分两支注入兴凯湖南端。十八世纪耶稣会传教士绘制的地图以满语名勒富毕拉标记这条河。

english: Shilik lies on the Bugun River, near the remains of the medieval settlement of Buzyktobe. The old town consisted of a citadel, an inner town and an outer quarter associated with craftsmen. Its earthen mounds preserve the outline of a settlement in the agricultural country east of Otrar, where the Bugun runs toward the Arys. The site is distinct from another medieval Shilik far away in the Ili valley.
simp_chinese: 什利克位于布贡河畔，靠近中世纪聚落布济克托别的遗址。古城由城堡、内城和与手工业者相联系的外城区组成，土丘保存着旧聚落的轮廓。这里是讹答剌以东的农业地区，布贡河向阿里斯河流去；这处遗址与远在伊犁河谷的另一座中世纪什利克并非同一地点。

english: Shílóng was the seat county of Huazhou in western Guangdong, named for a ridge north of the old town. The Southern Dynasties had set up Luozhou and Shilong Commandery here, and the Song renamed Bianzhou as Huazhou. The Ming made it a prefecture, then in 1374 reduced it to a department and merged Shilong County into it. In 1376 it was lowered to a county under Gaozhou, and in 1381 it became a department again, ruling Wuchuan and Shicheng counties. The Qing followed the Ming arrangement. The Jian, Luo and Ling rivers ran north to south through the district, and roads led from Huazhou to Gaozhou, Shicheng and Wuchuan.
simp_chinese: 石龙是广东西部化州的附郭县，因旧城北面的石龙冈得名。南朝时此地已设罗州和石龙郡，宋代辩州改名化州。明初升为府，洪武七年（1374年）降为州，石龙县并入化州；洪武九年（1376年）降为县，隶高州府；洪武十四年（1381年）又改为州，辖吴川、石城二县。清朝沿用明代建置。鉴江、罗江和陵江自北向南纵贯州境，驿道从化州城通往高州、石城和吴川。

english: Shílóu stands in the high country of western Shanxi, on the western flank of the Lüliang mountains above the Yellow River, and takes its name from the Stone Tower Mountain to the east, where piled rock resembles a tower. The Sui gave the county this name in 598. Burials and bronzes from sites such as Erlangpo show that people lived here as early as the Shang period. At Xingdongyuan village the Dongyue Temple keeps a main hall of the Jin dynasty with Ming murals; the temple was repaired in 1338 and again in 1641. In the hills near Zhangjiahe village stands a temple to Houtu, the earth mother, with halls built in the Ming and Qing.
simp_chinese: 石楼位于山西西部的高原，在吕梁山西麓，俯临黄河，县名来自县东的石楼山，山上叠石如楼。隋代于598年定名石楼县。二郎坡等遗址出土的墓葬和青铜器，显示这一带的聚落历史可追溯到商代。 兴东垣村的东岳庙，大殿为金代原构，殿内有明代壁画；元至元四年（1338年）和明崇祯十四年（1641年）都曾修葺。张家河村附近的山中有后土圣母庙，殿宇建于明清时期，供奉大地之母，是黄河东岸山区村落世代相传的信仰遗迹。

english:
Shilovo belongs to the Oka river country of the Ryazan region, where cultivated land and surrounding forests supported settlements linked with central Russian routes.
A place named Shilov appears among Ryazan towns in a late fourteenth-century list. Documents associated with the Shilovsky family describe land, fishing grounds and a toll on the Oka, reflecting the river's importance to local authority and exchange.
simp_chinese:
希洛沃属于梁赞地区奥卡河沿岸，耕地和周围森林支撑同俄罗斯中部路线相连的聚落。
十四世纪末的一份城镇名录在梁赞诸城中提到希洛夫。与希洛夫斯基家族有关的文书提到土地、渔场和奥卡河上的税费，反映河流对地方权威和交换的重要性。

english: Shima is a peninsula of intricate inlets and islands facing the Pacific. Its women divers, known as ama, gathered abalone and other seafood from the surrounding waters. In ancient times Shima supplied marine produce to the court, and its offerings were also connected with Ise Shrine. Tradition tells that the diver Oben offered abalone to Princess Yamatohime, who established a custom of presenting the shellfish to the shrine.
simp_chinese: 志摩半岛面向太平洋，海湾和岛屿曲折交错。当地被称为海女的女性潜水采集鲍鱼等海产。古代志摩向朝廷供应海产，物产也与伊势神宫的祭品相联系。传说海女御辨向倭姬命献上鲍鱼，公主因而立下向神宫进献鲍鱼的传统。

english: Shimabara Bay lies off the eastern shore of the volcanic Shimabara Peninsula, facing Higo across the Ariake Sea. In 1792 earthquakes shook the area during the activity of Mount Unzen. Part of Mount Mayuyama collapsed into the sea, sending a tsunami across the bay and devastating shores on both sides. The disaster became remembered in the phrase “Shimabara's catastrophe, Higo's misfortune.”
simp_chinese: 岛原湾位于火山遍布的岛原半岛东岸，与肥后隔有明海相望。1792年云仙岳活动期间，当地发生地震，眉山的一部分崩入海中，引发海啸，重创海湾两岸。这场灾难后来以“岛原大变、肥后迷惑”之名留在人们的记忆中。

english: Shimamaki lies on the Sea of Japan coast of western Ezo. Its Ainu name was given to a settlement and a trading district centered near the mouth of the Tomari River. During the late eighteenth century, fishermen from the Japanese settlements to the south followed the herring north around Cape Motsuta and into these waters. They paid a share of their catch to the merchant holding the rights to the district.
simp_chinese: 岛牧位于虾夷地西部的日本海沿岸。这个阿伊努语地名用于一处聚落，也用于以泊川河口附近为中心的交易场所。十八世纪后期，南方日本定居地的渔民追随鲱鱼北上，绕过茂津多岬进入这片海域，并将部分渔获交给拥有当地经营权的商人。

english: Shimbay lies in the lower Oxus delta, east of the river's main channel. Its market served communities among the waterways and cultivated lands of the Aral country. Karakalpak craftspeople made the wooden frames and coverings of the portable felt dwellings used across the steppe. In the early nineteenth century the khans of Khiva brought Karakalpaks from the eastern shore of the Aral Sea into the delta, where settlement and pastoral life met in a landscape shaped by the river.
simp_chinese: 申拜位于阿姆河下游三角洲，在河流主道以东。当地市场服务于咸海地区水道与耕地之间的诸多社群。卡拉卡尔帕克工匠制作草原上使用的可移动毡房的木架和覆盖物。十九世纪初，希瓦汗将卡拉卡尔帕克人从咸海东岸迁入三角洲；在这片由河流塑造的土地上，定居生活与牧业生活交汇。

english:
Shimen lies on the middle Li River in northwestern Hunan. The county was established under the Sui in 589 and was associated with Lizhou. In later centuries its mountain districts included territories governed by hereditary local chieftains, among them the Tan family of Tianping.

During the Qing, reforms of native chieftain jurisdictions brought changes to administration in the region. In 1730 Lizhou was raised to a directly administered prefecture under Hunan, with Shimen among its counties. The county's Confucian temple, originally founded in the Song, was moved to a new site in 1504 and repaired or rebuilt during the Qing.
simp_chinese:
石门位于湖南西北部澧水中游。隋开皇九年（589年）置石门县，隶属澧州。后世县境山地有世袭土司治理的地区，其中包括添平覃氏土司。

清代土司地区改土归流，区域行政随之变化。雍正八年（1730年），澧州升为湖南直隶州，石门为其属县。石门文庙始建于宋代，明弘治十七年（1504年）迁建，清代又多次修建，反映了县城长期的文教传统。

english: Shimen lies on the upper Zhangtian River in northern Poyang, close to the boundary between Jiangxi and Anhui. Once the seat of Guangjin County, it later became a town on the road between the two provinces. A postal station was established here under the Yuan, and merchants from different places came to trade at this border settlement.
simp_chinese: 石门位于鄱阳北部的漳田河上游，靠近江西与安徽的交界。此地曾是广晋县治所，后来成为两省间道路上的市镇。元代在此设驿站，来自各地的商人也来到这处边境聚落交易。

english: Shimian lies in the steep valley of the Dadu River, where tributaries cut through the mountains of western Sichuan. Old paths climbed the slopes above the water and linked the river country with communities farther southwest. A section of the tea and horse road through Xieluo dates to the Qing, passing fortified villages whose stone and timber houses stand above the deep valleys.
simp_chinese: 石棉位于大渡河深谷之中，支流切穿川西群山。古道沿江水上方的山坡攀升，将河谷与西南方的聚落连接起来。经过蟹螺的一段茶马古道可追溯至清代，沿途有堡寨，石木房屋高踞深谷之上。

english:
Shimoagata belongs to the southern part of Tsushima, the mountainous island between the Japanese archipelago and the Korean peninsula. Limited farmland encouraged reliance on fishing, woodland resources, and exchange with other shores. Harbours and coastal routes connected settlements separated by rugged terrain, while the island's position gave local seafaring knowledge a significance extending beyond subsistence. Movement across the strait could bring both commercial opportunity and political danger.

The Sō family governed Tsushima and became an important intermediary in relations between Japan and Korea. Its castle town was Tsushima Fuchū, present-day Izuhara, in the south of the island. After the Japanese invasions of Korea disrupted relations in the 1590s, the Sō worked to restore them: a Korean mission came to Japan in 1607, and trade resumed in 1609. The island's ports and interpreters remained important to communication across the strait.
simp_chinese:
下县属于对马南部，这座多山岛屿位于日本列岛与朝鲜半岛之间。耕地有限，使居民依靠捕鱼、森林资源和跨海交换。港湾与沿岸路线连接被崎岖地形分开的聚落，岛屿位置又使地方航海知识具有超出生计本身的意义。穿越海峡既能带来商业机会，也可能造成政治危险，海面因此始终受到特别关注。

宗氏统治对马，并在日本与朝鲜关系中承担重要中介角色。其城下町对马府中即今岛南的严原。十六世纪九十年代日本侵朝战争破坏双方关系后，宗氏致力恢复往来：1607年朝鲜使节来到日本，1609年贸易重新开始。岛上的港口和通译继续承担海峡两岸通信的重要任务。

english: Shimoga lies on the Tunga River in inland Karnataka, near the hill country of the Western Ghats. The wider region came under Vijayanagara rule in the fifteenth century. The Nayakas of Keladi, based in the district, initially governed as Vijayanagara's dependants and became independent after the empire's decline in the later sixteenth century. Their power extended across parts of the Malnad hills and Karnataka coast. In 1763 Hyder Ali defeated the Keladi rulers and incorporated their territory into Mysore. Shimoga's river setting placed it within a region connected by routes between the forested uplands, coast and Deccan interior; the history of the Keladi state is regional context rather than a record of events at every settlement.
simp_chinese: 希莫加位于卡纳塔克内陆的通加河畔，靠近西高止山丘陵地区。十五世纪，广大地区处于毗阇耶那伽罗统治之下。以本地区凯拉迪为据点的纳亚克家族最初依附毗阇耶那伽罗，在帝国于十六世纪后期衰落后独立，其势力延及马尔纳德山地与卡纳塔克沿海的部分地区。1763年，海德尔·阿里击败凯拉迪统治者，将其领地纳入迈索尔。希莫加的河畔位置处在连接林地高地、海岸和德干腹地的道路之间；凯拉迪国家的历史属于区域背景，不能视为每个聚落的具体史事。

english: Shimohei lies on the Sanriku coast of Mutsu, where wooded mountains descend to Miyako Bay. Under the Tokugawa shogunate, Morioka domain chose Miyako as a port for trade with Edo. Roads carried goods and seafood between the port and Morioka, and merchants known as isabashū took part in this traffic. The sheltered bay gave ships a foothold along a coast deeply divided by headlands and inlets.
simp_chinese: 下闭伊位于陆奥三陆海岸，森林山地向宫古湾下降。德川时代，盛冈藩选择宫古港经营与江户的贸易。道路连接港口与盛冈，运送货物和海产，称为“五十集众”的商人也参与其事。这座避风海湾为船只提供落脚处，周围海岸则被岬角与海湾深深分割。

english: Shimoina occupies the southern part of the Ina valley, where the Tenryū River runs between the mountains of Shinano. Iida Castle stood on a terrace above the river, commanding a town and its surrounding lands. Under the Tokugawa shogunate the castle became the seat of the Iida domain. The Hori family took possession in 1672 and held it for the remainder of the period of warrior government.
simp_chinese: 下伊那位于伊那谷南部，天龙川从信浓的群山之间流过。饭田城坐落在河畔台地上，俯瞰城下町及周边土地。德川幕府统治下，这座城成为饭田藩的中心；堀氏于1672年入主，此后一直统治到武家政权的末期。

english: Shimokita projects north from Mutsu towards Ezo, separating Mutsu Bay from the Pacific and the Tsugaru Strait. At Tanabu, a river port served the peninsula's coastal communities. By the late sixteenth century Nanbu authorities had granted exemptions from ship dues to certain merchants calling at its ports. Timber and goods carried across the strait linked this northern peninsula with neighbouring coasts.
simp_chinese: 下北半岛从陆奥向北伸向虾夷，将陆奥湾与太平洋、津轻海峡隔开。田名部的河港服务半岛沿岸聚落。十六世纪末，南部氏已准许若干来访商船免缴船役；木材与渡海货物把这处北方半岛同邻近海岸联系起来。

english: The strait at Shimonoseki separates Honshū from Kyūshū and joins the Seto Inland Sea to the waters west of Japan. It narrows to a few hundred metres at Hayatomo, where the tide races through and reverses direction with the changing sea level. Here, at Dan-no-ura in 1185, the Minamoto defeated the Taira in a naval battle remembered for the death of the young Emperor Antoku beneath the waves.
simp_chinese: 下关海峡分隔本州与九州，将濑户内海与日本西部海域连接起来。海峡在早鞆濑户收窄至数百米，潮水急速通过，并随海面涨落改变方向。1185年，源氏在此处坛之浦的海战中击败平氏；幼帝安德天皇沉入波涛的故事，也使这场战役长久留在人们记忆中。

english: Shimushiru is a long volcanic island near the centre of the Kuril chain. Its Ainu name means a large island, and its mountains rise steeply above the sea. Eighteenth-century accounts describe Ainu inhabitants travelling seasonally to Chirpoi, where they hunted birds and traded with people arriving from Urup. Such journeys linked the central and southern islands through the exchange of food and goods.
simp_chinese: 新知是千岛群岛中部一座狭长的火山岛，阿伊努语岛名意为“大岛”，山峦从海边陡然升起。十八世纪的记载称，岛上阿伊努人随季节前往知理保以岛捕鸟，并与从得抚岛来的人交换货物。这些航行使中部和南部岛屿相互联系。

english: The Shin Shin mountains rise in the northern Peruvian highlands west of Cutervo. Forest clings to their slopes in a region where the Andes are divided by deep valleys and river courses. The ridges belong to the mountain country of Cajamarca, between the Pacific-facing slopes and the great Marañón basin that drains towards the Amazon.
simp_chinese: 辛辛山脉耸立在秘鲁北部高地、库特尔沃以西。森林覆盖山坡，深谷和河流切开这一带的安第斯山地。山脊属于卡哈马卡山地，位于面向太平洋的山坡与流向亚马孙的广大马拉尼翁流域之间。

sources.title: estudios de bosques en la region cajamarca.pdf

english: Shīnán was a hereditary native chiefship in the mountains of western Hubei. Its rulers held office under the Yuan and Ming, and their territory included several settlements around the upper river valleys. In the early Qing the chief Shàn Zàidǐng became entangled in conflicts with officials as the court sought to replace hereditary offices with appointed government. In 1735 Shīnán and several neighbouring chiefships were reorganised into Lìchuān County, ending the old native jurisdiction.
simp_chinese: 施南是湖北西部山区的世袭土司，元明时期历代首领在上游河谷及其周围行使权力。清初朝廷逐渐寻求以流官取代土司，施南土司单再鼎与官府的关系也趋于紧张。雍正十三年（1735年），施南和邻近几个土司辖地改归流官，合设利川县。

english:
Shinas belongs to the Batinah coast of northern Oman, where cultivated strips and date gardens lie between the sea and mountain approaches. Fishing, farming, livestock, and local trade supply complementary resources. Boats connect coastal settlements, while paths lead inland toward water sources and neighboring valleys. The relationship between maritime access and carefully managed cultivation gives small ports and villages a role beyond their immediate land.

The wider Omani coast participated in Indian Ocean networks linking Arabia with Iran, India and eastern Africa. Shinas also became involved in struggles for control of the coast. In 1810 forces of the Omani ruler Said and the British attacked and captured the town; it was subsequently retaken after their withdrawal. The surviving fort reflects the importance of defended coastal settlements in this region.
simp_chinese:
希纳斯属于阿曼北部巴提纳海岸，农带椰枣园处在海洋与山区之间。捕鱼、农业、牲畜和贸易互补。舟船联系岸边聚落，小径通向内陆水源谷地。海上入口与精心耕作关系，让小港村作用超出有限土地。

更广阔的阿曼海岸参与连接阿拉伯、伊朗、印度和东非的印度洋网络。希纳斯也卷入沿海控制权的争夺。1810年，阿曼统治者赛义德与英国的军队攻占此城；联军撤离后，城镇又被夺回。现存堡垒体现了设防海岸聚落在这一地区的重要性。

english:
El Shincal de Quimivil lies at the foot of the mountains south of the Hualfín valley. Built by the Inca in the late fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries, it was one of their great centres in the southern Andes. A broad central plaza held an ushnu, a stone platform from which ceremonies could be presided over. Large halls, storehouses, residential enclosures and a stone aqueduct surrounded the civic centre.

The Inca incorporated northwestern Argentina into Kollasuyu, the southern quarter of their empire. At Shincal, two hills flanking the plaza were levelled and provided with stairways, and were associated with solar worship. Roads connected the centre with agricultural lands and other installations. Occupation continued after the collapse of Inca rule, into the colonial period and the indigenous uprising of the 1630s. Its carefully ordered buildings show how imperial authority took physical form far from Cuzco.
simp_chinese:
辛卡尔德基米维尔位于瓦尔芬河谷以南的山麓。印加人在十五世纪末至十六世纪初修建了这座中心，它是帝国在南安第斯的重要据点之一。宽阔的中央广场上设有乌什努石台，主持仪式的人可登台举行典礼。大厅、仓库、居住围屋和石砌引水渠环绕着中心区。

印加人将阿根廷西北部纳入帝国南方的科利亚苏尤。在辛卡尔，广场两侧的山丘被削平，并建有阶梯，与太阳崇拜有关。道路将中心与农田和其他设施相连。印加统治崩溃后，这里仍有人居住，延续至殖民时期和1630年代的原住民起义。整齐布局的建筑展现了远离库斯科的帝国权威如何在地方体现。

english: Shindand occupies the district once known as Asfezar, south of Herat on the road toward Farah and Sistan. Its river, the Adraskan or Harut, flows from the western mountains of central Afghanistan toward the Sistan basin. The town was later called Sabzavar of Herat, a name distinguishing it from the better-known Sabzavar near Nishapur. Scholars from the district bore the name Asfezari, including the fifteenth-century historian of Herat Muin al-Din Zamchi.
simp_chinese: 信丹德位于旧称阿斯费扎尔的地区，在赫拉特以南通往法拉和锡斯坦的道路上。当地的阿德拉斯坎河又称哈鲁特河，从阿富汗中部西缘的山地流向锡斯坦盆地。这座城后来称为赫拉特的萨卜泽瓦尔，以区别于内沙布尔附近更著名的同名城市。出身此地的学者以“阿斯费扎里”为称号，其中包括十五世纪的赫拉特史家穆因丁·扎姆奇。

english:
Shineha belongs to the Pacific side of northeastern Honshu, in the historical region of Iwaki. Narrow coastal lowlands meet wooded hills rising toward the interior. Rice cultivation used favourable valleys and water management, while fishing supplemented farming. Roads connected coastal and inland districts across terrain affected by seasonal weather.

In medieval northeastern Japan, warrior families built authority through estates, castles and alliances. The Sōma family became important along this coast. Under Tokugawa rule, domains and villages operated within a more stable hierarchy, while taxes and harvests continued to shape rural life. Temples, shrines and communal festivals helped organise religious and social obligations.
simp_chinese:
标叶属于本州东北太平洋沿岸的磐城历史地区，狭窄的海岸低地与内陆林丘相接。稻作利用适宜的谷地和水利设施，捕鱼则补充农业。道路连接海岸与内陆各地，地形和季节天气影响运输。

中世纪日本东北部的武家通过庄园、城堡和联盟建立权力，相马氏在这一沿海地区尤其重要。德川时期，藩与村落处于较稳定的等级秩序之中，赋税和收成仍影响乡村生活。寺院、神社与共同节庆也帮助安排宗教和社会义务。

english: Shingwako is an Ojibwe name associated with the Pine River, which flows through the lakes and forests of northern Minnesota toward the Mississippi. Its course passes through a chain of lakes, including the waters known as Whitefish and Rush Lake. The Ojibwe name of the latter described a pine projecting from the water, while the river’s name referred to pine itself. Together, these names preserve a picture of a wooded waterway threaded through the lake country.
simp_chinese: 辛瓦科是与松河有关的奥吉布瓦语名称。这条河穿过明尼苏达北部的湖泊与森林，流向密西西比河。河道经过一连串湖泊，包括白鱼湖和拉什湖。后者的奥吉布瓦语名称描述了一棵从水中伸出的松树，河名本身也与松树有关。这些名字共同描绘出一条穿行于湖泊地带的林间水道。

english: Shinobu lies in the Fukushima basin of Mutsu, where the Abukuma River flows beneath the mountains of the north. Fukushima Castle and its town became a centre of local government under the Tokugawa shogunate. In 1702 Itakura Shigehiro entered the castle as lord of Fukushima, beginning a succession of Itakura rulers. The town stood on the road through the basin, linking the castle with neighbouring districts.
simp_chinese: 信夫位于陆奥福岛盆地，阿武隈川从北方群山脚下流过。德川幕府时期，福岛城及其城下町成为地方统治中心。1702年板仓重宽入主福岛城，开启板仓氏历代藩主的统治。城下町坐落在穿越盆地的道路上，与邻近诸郡相连。

english: The Hidaka coast faces the Pacific along the southern shore of Ezo. Rivers run down from the mountains, bringing salmon into reach of the Ainu communities of the region. Fishing with clubs and spears supplied households, while commercial fisheries later developed along the coast. Offshore, cold water and moist air can produce sea fog, hiding the shore and making the weather a vital concern for travelers by boat.
simp_chinese: 日高海岸位于虾夷地南缘，面向太平洋。河流从群山奔向大海，使当地阿伊努社区能够捕捉洄游的鲑鱼。人们用棒和鱼叉捕鱼供家中食用，沿岸后来又发展出商业渔业。近海冷水与湿润空气可形成海雾，遮蔽海岸，使乘船出行的人必须留意天气。

english: Shionomisaki is the southernmost point of Honshū, projecting from the Kii Peninsula into the Pacific. Once an island, it became joined to the mainland by a sandbar at Kushimoto. Cliffs descend from its broad rocky heights to waters warmed by the Kuroshio Current, which passes close to the coast. The warm sea supports corals at the northern edge of their range.
simp_chinese: 潮岬是本州最南端，从纪伊半岛伸入太平洋。它原本是一座岛屿，后来由串本的沙洲与本土相连。宽阔的岩石台地向海陡降成崖，附近的黑潮为海水带来暖意。这片温暖水域也让处于分布北限附近的珊瑚得以生长。

english: The Shioya warrior family held lands around Yaita for centuries. Its members used castles including Gozenhara and Kawasaki, and the family lost its lordship during Toyotomi Hideyoshi's unification campaigns.
simp_chinese: 盐谷武士家族曾长期掌握矢板一带的土地，使用过御前原城和川崎城等城堡。丰臣秀吉统一日本期间，盐谷氏失去领地。

english: Shioya Cape projects into the Pacific from the coast of Iwaki. Fishing settlements lie on either side, with Toyoma to the south and Usuiso and Numanouchi to the north. Along this shore fishermen worked the rocky coastal waters, using the natural features of the inlets to reach the sea. The cape stands between stretches of exposed shore, where reefs lie offshore and waves break against the land.
simp_chinese: 盐屋崎从磐城海岸伸入太平洋。岬角两侧分布着渔村：南边是丰间，北边有薄矶和沼之内。当地渔民利用海岸的天然地形出海，在近岸岩礁间捕鱼。岬角两侧的海岸直面大洋，近海礁石散布，浪涛拍打着岸边。

english: Shípái stands on the Hàn River in the fertile Jianghan Plain. During the Míng and Qīng it became a gathering place for grain from both banks, with merchants and boats contributing to a busy riverside market. A local tradition traces its name to a stone archway by the river, used by boatmen as a landmark for landing.
simp_chinese: 石牌位于汉江畔的江汉平原。明清时期，这里是两岸米粮集散地，商贾和船只汇聚，形成繁忙的河边市镇。当地传说其名来自江岸的石牌坊，船民以此为标记停靠。

english: Shipastouk is a channel in the watery country west of Lake Mistassini. It leaves Radisson Bay and rejoins the Rupert River near Lake Capichinatoune, taking a shorter course than the river's loop around Peuvereau Island. Islands and falls interrupt its passage through the forest. From here the Rupert continues west towards James Bay; Cree people have lived around Mistassini and throughout its watershed for thousands of years.
simp_chinese: 希帕斯托克是一条位于米斯塔西尼湖以西水乡的河道，从拉迪松湾流出，在卡皮希纳图恩湖附近重新汇入鲁珀特河。它比绕过珀维罗岛的鲁珀特河主道更短，途中穿过森林，经过岛屿和瀑布。鲁珀特河从这一带继续西流，通向詹姆斯湾；克里人数千年来生活在米斯塔西尼湖及其流域。

english:
Shiping lies among the hills and lakes of southern Yunnan, near Yilong Lake. The old town preserves a tradition of scholarship reflected in its Confucian temple, academies and residences of local scholars. Its name was once written Shípíng, recalling a level stone associated with the settlement’s origin. The town stands in a broad basin ringed by hills, with the lake close to its eastern side.

Under the Ming and Qing, Shiping became known for learning and the accomplishments of its examination candidates. Local gazetteers recorded the works and careers of its scholars, while families built houses and ancestral halls in the town. The surrounding lake and cultivated basin provided a setting for a community whose written culture continued across generations.
simp_chinese:
石屏位于云南南部丘陵湖泊之间，靠近异龙湖。古城的文庙、书院和士人宅第反映出当地重视学问的传统。地名旧作石平，传说与建城时发现的一块平石有关。城镇坐落在群山环绕的宽阔盆地中，东侧紧邻湖泊。

明清时期，石屏因文教和科举人才闻名。地方志记录士人的著作与仕途，城中家族也修建住宅和宗祠。周围湖泊与耕作盆地为这座地方城镇提供了环境，书写和学习的传统在这里代代延续。

english: The Shipshaw flows south through the wooded country north of the Saguenay, carrying the waters of Lake Onatchiway towards the larger river. Its Innu name is commonly interpreted as the “enclosed river”, a fitting description of a watercourse winding through a confined valley. River routes and portages in this country led into the interior; the trading post at Chicoutimi became a place of supply for the fur trade beyond them. Innu hunters knew the forests and lakes upstream long before the arrival of the traders.
simp_chinese: 希普肖河流经萨格奈以北的森林，向南将奥纳奇韦湖的水带往萨格奈河。它的因努语名称通常被解释为“受围困的河”，形容河水在狭窄谷地中曲折流淌。这一带的河道和搬舟路通向内陆，希库蒂米贸易站成为更远地区毛皮贸易的补给点。商人到来之前，因努猎人早已熟悉上游森林和湖泊。

english: Shiqian lies among the mountains of eastern Guizhou, where warm springs rise near the town. The Ming established Shiqian Prefecture in 1413, when Guizhou became a province, and a Confucian temple was founded in the same year. Successive prefects repaired and enlarged the baths south of the town. By the late Ming the springs had become one of Shiqian's celebrated sights, drawing visitors to the warm water beneath the mountain slopes and inspiring poems in the local gazetteers.
simp_chinese: 石阡位于贵州东部山地，城南有温泉涌出。1413年贵州建省，明朝在此设石阡府，同年兴建府文庙。历任知府修葺、扩建城南浴池；到明代晚期，温泉已列为石阡著名景致之一。游人前来山下沐浴，地方志也保存了文人咏泉的诗作。

english: Shiquan stands on a rocky terrace on the north bank of the Han River, surrounded by mountains. Its name, meaning stone springs, recalls the clear water emerging from rocks south of the town. The Ming rebuilt its walls in 1369, and later magistrates reinforced them with brick and stone. Floods repeatedly damaged the riverside defences. In 1798 forces of the White Lotus uprising fought Qing troops at Shiquan while seeking to cross the Han and enter Sichuan.
simp_chinese: 石泉城坐落在汉江北岸的石台上，四周群山环绕。县名取自城南石隙中流出的清泉。明朝于1369年重建城墙，后来的知县又用砖石加固；滨江城垣屡遭洪水冲毁。1798年，白莲教起义军试图渡过汉江入川，在石泉与清军激战。

english: South Shiquan lies in the mountain country northeast of Maozhou, in the valleys that descend toward the Sichuan Basin. Shiquan County was established under the Tang in 634, taking its name from the springs and stony landscape of the district. The rugged routes through these mountains joined the basin to the borderlands beyond, and the county was administered as part of a succession of frontier prefectures. Its name distinguishes this Shiquan from another county of the same name farther north in Shaanxi.
simp_chinese: 南石泉位于茂州东北的山区，山谷向四川盆地一侧延伸。唐贞观八年（634）设石泉县，以当地石泉得名。这片崎岖山地中的道路连接盆地与边地，石泉县先后隶属不同的边地州府。这里的石泉与更北面陕西境内的同名县并非一处。

english: Shira lies in the country between the Hausa states and Bornu, on a route that also reached toward Adamawa. The old settlement stood on rocky heights above the later town, and archaeological evidence points to a long period of occupation. Local traditions recall Shira alongside the neighbouring settlements of Tashena and Auyo, each with its own rulers before the upheavals of the nineteenth century. In 1807 Malam Zaki took Shira during the wars associated with the Sokoto jihad, bringing a new power into this region of small chiefdoms.
simp_chinese: 希拉位于豪萨诸国与博尔努之间，一条道路从这里通向阿达马瓦。旧聚落坐落在后来城镇上方的岩石高地，考古发现显示这里曾长期有人居住。地方传统常将希拉与邻近的塔谢纳、奥约并提；十九世纪动荡之前，这些地方各有统治者。1807年，在与索科托圣战相关的战争中，马拉姆·扎基攻占希拉，将新的权力带入这个由众多小酋邦组成的地区。

english: Shira Qulusun lies in the Trans-Altai Gobi, where scattered oases interrupt the desert basins south of the mountains. Known as Shar Khuls, it is one of the water places associated with the Gobi bear, a desert-dwelling population of brown bears. Springs and vegetation form small refuges amid rocky plains and arid valleys, sustaining wildlife in one of the driest parts of Mongolia.
simp_chinese: 希拉呼鲁孙位于阿尔泰山以南的外阿尔泰戈壁，零散绿洲点缀着山南荒漠盆地。这里又称沙尔呼勒斯，是戈壁熊活动的水源地之一；戈壁熊是适应荒漠生活的棕熊种群。泉水与植被在石质平原和干谷间形成小小庇护所，供养蒙古最干旱地区之一的野生动物。

english: Shirakawa guards a passage between the Kantō plain and the northern provinces of Mutsu. Its castle town grew beside the Abukuma River, beneath the walls of Komine Castle. In 1627 Niwa Nagashige became the first lord of the Shirakawa domain and began a major rebuilding of the stronghold. The river was diverted to provide land for residences, and stone walls helped turn Komine into a fortress at the gateway to the north.
simp_chinese: 白河扼守关东平原与陆奥北方诸地之间的通道。城下町在阿武隈川畔发展，上方是小峰城的城墙。1627年，丹羽长重成为白河藩首任藩主，着手大规模改修城郭。他改移河道以开辟宅地，广泛使用石垣，使小峰城成为北方门户上的坚城。

english: Shiranuka lies on the Pacific coast of eastern Ezo, where river valleys descend through wooded hills to the sea. A trading district was established here in 1632. During the Ainu uprising of 1669, thirteen Japanese were killed at Shiranuka. In 1800 the shogunate sent fifty members of the Hachiōji guard under Hara Hanzaemon to settle and cultivate the land, but illness and poor agricultural results undermined the venture, and the settlement organization was dissolved in 1804.
simp_chinese: 白糠位于虾夷地东部的太平洋海岸，河谷穿过森林丘陵通向大海。一六三二年，这里设立了交易场所。一六六九年阿伊努人起事时，十三名日本人在白糠遇害。一八〇〇年，幕府派原半左卫门率领五十名八王子千人同心来此定居开垦，但疾病和不佳的耕作成果使计划受挫，一八〇四年屯田组织解散。

english:
Shiraoi belongs to the southern coast of Hokkaido, where rivers, forests, and Pacific waters support resources used by Ainu communities. Salmon, marine fish, game, and gathered plants supply complementary foods, while woodland materials serve buildings, boats, and household equipment. Seasonal work links river mouths and inland resource grounds, and travel depends on local knowledge of weather and water. The landscape carries named places and social relationships that predate later Japanese administrative divisions.

In the Edo period the Matsumae domain maintained a trading establishment near the mouth of the Shiraoi River, through which it traded with Ainu people along this coast. Ainu traditions also preserve stories connected with local places such as Lake Kuttara and the Ayoro coast. These histories belong to an Indigenous homeland as well as to the changing commercial frontier of northern Japan.
simp_chinese:
白老属于北海道南岸，河流、森林和太平洋提供阿伊努资源。鲑鱼、海鱼、猎物和采集食物互补，林木制作建筑舟船器具。季节劳动联系河口内陆，交通依赖天气水情。地名社会关系早于后来日本行政划分。

江户时代，松前藩在白老川河口附近设立会所，与沿海阿伊努人进行交易。阿伊努传统也保存着与俱多乐湖、阿约罗海岸等地点有关的故事。这些历史属于原住民的家园，也与日本北方商业边疆的变化相联系。

english: Shirashima Cape is the northern tip of Dōgo, the largest island of the Oki Islands, off the coast of western Honshu. From the late Heian period Oki served as a place of political exile: Emperor Go-Toba was sent there in 1221 and died on the islands, and Emperor Go-Daigo was exiled to Oki in 1332 before he escaped and regained power. Fishermen and coastal shippers worked the rough waters between the islands and the Honshu shore, where headlands, reefs and changing winds demanded careful navigation.
simp_chinese: 白岛崎是隐岐群岛中最大岛屿岛后的北端，位于本州西部外海。平安时代后期，隐岐成为政治流放之地：1221年后鸟羽上皇被流放至此，并死于岛上；1332年后醍醐天皇也被流放隐岐，后来逃脱并重新掌权。渔民和沿海航运者在群岛与本州海岸之间的险恶海域往来，岬角、礁石和多变的风向要求谨慎领航。

english:
Shiraz, the great city of Fars, lies in a cool valley of the Zagros ringed by gardens, vineyards and orchards. Its poets Sa'di and Hafez made its name known across the Persian-speaking world, while shrines, madrasas and bazaars drew scholars, pilgrims and merchants. The tomb of Ahmad ibn Musa, known as Shah Cheragh, was among its most revered sanctuaries, and the wine and roses of its gardens became a byword for pleasure.

Ibn Battuta visited Shiraz in 1347 and found a populous city with separate bazaars for each trade. Under the Muzaffarid ruler Shah Shuja, Hafez wrote at his court, and when Timur approached in the 1380s Shah Shuja submitted and the city was spared. The Shiraz school of manuscript painting flourished under the Timurids, and the Aq Qoyunlu made the city a capital in the fifteenth century. Ismail I took Shiraz in 1504. Under the Safavids it remained the provincial capital of Fars, and Imam Quli Khan, governor under Abbas I, raised palaces and a madrasa in the manner of Isfahan.

After the Afghan raids and a siege and sack by Nader Shah's troops, the population fell to about fifty thousand. In 1762 Karim Khan Zand made Shiraz his capital and rebuilt it with a citadel, the Vakil Mosque, public baths and the covered Vakil Bazaar, together with a moat and new walls. He also repaired the neglected tombs of Sa'di and Hafez. After his death the Zand house split, and Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar took Shiraz in 1792, pulled down its walls and moved the capital north to Tehran.
simp_chinese:
设拉子是法尔斯的大城，坐落在扎格罗斯山间凉爽的山谷里，四周环绕着花园、葡萄园和果园。诗人萨迪和哈菲兹让它的名字传遍波斯语世界，圣陵、经学院和巴扎吸引着学者、朝圣者和商人。被称为沙赫切拉格的艾哈迈德·伊本·穆萨陵是城中最受崇敬的圣所之一，园中的美酒与玫瑰则成了欢乐的代名词。

伊本·白图泰于1347年到访设拉子，见到人口众多的城市和按行业分设的巴扎。穆扎法尔王朝的沙·舒贾在位时，哈菲兹在他的宫廷中写作；14世纪80年代帖木儿逼近，沙·舒贾投降，城市因此幸免。帖木儿时期设拉子的手抄本绘画学派兴盛，白羊王朝在15世纪以此为都。1504年伊斯玛仪一世攻取设拉子。萨法维时期它仍是法尔斯省会，阿拔斯一世手下的总督伊玛目·库利汗仿照伊斯法罕的样式兴建宫殿和经学院。

阿富汗人的劫掠，加上纳迪尔沙军队的围城与洗劫，使人口降到约五万。1762年，卡里姆汗·赞德定都设拉子，大加重建，修起城堡、瓦基勒清真寺、公共浴室和有顶的瓦基勒巴扎，还开凿了护城河、重筑城墙，并修缮久失维护的萨迪墓和哈菲兹墓。他死后赞德家族分裂，1792年阿迦·穆罕默德汗·卡扎尔攻占设拉子，拆毁城防，把首都北移到德黑兰。

english:
Shire lies in the northern Ethiopian highlands, west of Axum, on the plateau of western Tigray. Its fields of barley and teff sit among escarpments and valleys, and the land has been farmed for a very long time. The region's human history reaches back to the age of the Aksumite kingdom and beyond, when the rulers of Axum drew on the highlands for food and labour.

An early mention of the place survives in a charter of Emperor Dawit I, who ruled around the turn of the fifteenth century. The charter shows the Solomonic kings already administering the western highlands through grants and privileges to local churches and lords. The name Shire also covers the wider country of western Tigray, which lay on the routes between the highlands and the western lowlands.
simp_chinese:
希雷位于埃塞俄比亚北部高地，在阿克苏姆以西，处于提格雷西部的台地上。大麦与苔麸田地散布在断崖和谷地之间，这片土地耕种已有很长的历史。该地区的人类历史可以追溯至阿克苏姆王国时代，甚至更早，当时阿克苏姆的统治者便从高原获取粮食与劳力。

希雷的早期记载保存在皇帝达维特一世的一份特许状中，他的统治时间大约在十五世纪之初。该特许状显示，所罗门王朝的君主已通过赐予地方教会与领主的特权来管理西部高地。“希雷”之名也涵盖提格雷西部更广阔的地区，这一带位于高原与西部低地之间的道路上。

english: Shirepa Cape rises at the entrance to Akkeshi Bay on the Pacific coast of eastern Ezo. Its Ainu name describes the head of a mountain projecting toward the sea, a name shared by several capes around the island. In 1643 the Dutch East India Company ship Castricum entered Akkeshi Bay and gave this headland the name Cape Santanel. Across the entrance lies Daikoku Island, home to nesting seabirds.
simp_chinese: 知来岬耸立在虾夷地东部太平洋海岸的厚岸湾入口。它的阿伊努语名称描绘伸向大海的山头，岛上数处海岬也有同源名称。一六四三年，荷兰东印度公司船只“卡斯特里克姆”号进入厚岸湾，将此岬命名为圣塔内尔角。湾口对面的大黑岛是海鸟繁殖之地。

english: Shiriya Cape marks the northeastern end of the Shimokita Peninsula, at the eastern entrance to the Tsugaru Strait. Rocks extend offshore, and the meeting of waters from the strait and the Pacific creates complex currents. Sailors feared the headland for its danger to ships. The warm Tsugaru Current leaves the strait here, often turning south along the coast in winter and spring and extending farther north during summer and autumn.
simp_chinese: 尻屋崎是下北半岛东北端的海岬，位于津轻海峡东口。岩礁伸向外海，海峡与太平洋水流相遇，形成复杂的潮流；航海者因船只容易在此遇险而畏惧这处岬角。津轻暖流从海峡流出后，冬春常沿海岸南下，夏秋则伸展得更靠北。

english:
Shirvan stretched along the eastern Caucasus towards the Caspian, encompassing mountain slopes, grain-growing lowlands and cities on the coastal road. Its rulers, the Shirvanshahs, maintained a long-lived dynasty whose principal centers included Shamakhi and Shabran. The region stood between the powers of Iran and the northern Caucasus, and its towns carried goods between the interior and the sea.

Safavid expansion brought the rule of the Shirvanshahs to an end in the sixteenth century. Shirvan later became a battleground for Ottoman, Iranian and Russian ambitions: a 1724 agreement divided the Caspian coast around Baku from the inland country governed from Shamakhi. After Nader Shah's death, a Shirvan khanate emerged; from 1768 to 1774 it came under Fath-Ali Khan of Quba. The khanate was drawn into the rivalry between Russia and Qajar Iran at the turn of the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese:
希尔凡沿高加索东部向里海延伸，包括山坡、种植谷物的低地和沿海道路上的城市。统治此地的希尔凡沙维持了一个长久的王朝，其主要中心包括沙马基和沙布兰。地区位于伊朗与北高加索诸势力之间，城镇将内陆货物运往海岸。

十六世纪萨法维扩张结束了希尔凡沙的统治。此后，希尔凡成为奥斯曼、伊朗与俄国势力争夺的战场：1724年的协定将巴库附近的里海沿岸与由沙马基治理的内陆地区分开。纳迪尔沙死后，希尔凡汗国兴起；1768至1774年间，它受库巴的法塔利汗统辖。十八、十九世纪之交，汗国又被卷入俄国与卡扎尔伊朗的竞争。

english: Shirvan lies in the Atrak valley of northern Khorasan, between Bojnurd and Quchan. Near the settlement of Ziyarat stands an old octagonal tomb, built of brick and pierced by arched entrances. A grave inscription records the year 785 of the Islamic calendar, corresponding to 1383–84, though the building's dating and the identity of its occupant have been debated. The monument is a reminder of the long history of the valley and its communities.
simp_chinese: 希尔万位于呼罗珊北部阿特雷克河谷，在博季努尔德与古昌之间。附近的齐亚拉特村有一座古老的八角墓塔，以砖砌成，入口呈拱形。墓碑记有伊斯兰历785年，即公元1383至1384年，不过建筑年代和墓主身份仍有争论。这座遗迹见证了河谷及其居民悠久的历史。

english: The Shish flows through the forests and wetlands east of the Irtysh before joining that river near Ust-Shish. It rises in the Vasyugan bog country and winds across the western Siberian lowlands. In its lower course it turns north-west and runs for a time parallel to the Irtysh, then bends south-west towards their meeting. Its tributaries include the Bolshoy Kutis, which enters from the right.
simp_chinese: 希什河流经额尔齐斯河以东的森林和湿地，在乌斯季希什附近汇入额尔齐斯河。它发源于瓦休甘沼泽地带，蜿蜒穿过西西伯利亚低地。下游河道转向西北，一段路程与额尔齐斯河平行，随后折向西南，与大河交汇。右岸汇入的大库季斯河是其支流之一。

english: Shishgarh lies in the northern plain near Bareilly, in the country known as Rohilkhand. During the eighteenth century Bareilly became a centre of the Rohilla Afghans, whose power extended over the surrounding region. In 1774 the combined forces of Awadh and the East India Company defeated the Rohilla leader Hafiz Rahmat Khan. Awadh acquired the region, and in 1801 the nawab ceded Bareilly and neighbouring territory to the Company.
simp_chinese: 希什加尔位于巴雷利附近的北印度平原，属于罗希尔坎德地区。十八世纪，巴雷利成为罗希拉阿富汗人的中心，其势力遍及周围地区。1774年，阿瓦德和东印度公司的联军击败罗希拉领袖哈菲兹·拉赫马特汗。此后阿瓦德取得这片地区；1801年，纳瓦布又将巴雷利及邻近领土割让给公司。

english: Shishmarev Inlet is a coastal lagoon on the northern side of the Seward Peninsula, separated from the Chukchi Sea by a chain of low islands. At its mouth lies Qigiqtaq, an Iñupiat settlement whose people have long hunted and fished along this coast. In 1816 the navigator Otto von Kotzebue named the inlet for an officer of his expedition, Gleb Shishmarev. Ice and open water offer very different ways of travelling through the lagoon as the seasons turn.
simp_chinese: 希什马廖夫湾是苏厄德半岛北岸的一处海岸潟湖，一列低矮岛屿将它与楚克奇海分开。湾口的基吉克塔克是因纽皮雅特人的聚落，居民长久以来沿岸狩猎和捕鱼。1816年，航海家奥托·冯·科策布以探险队军官格列布·希什马廖夫的名字为海湾命名。季节更替时，冰面与开阔水面为穿越潟湖提供了截然不同的道路。

english: Shíshǒu lies beside the Yangtze on the southern edge of the Jianghan Plain. Its name is traditionally traced to a solitary rock on the riverbank at the head of a northern hill. The county belonged to Jīngzhōu Prefecture under the Míng, amid the river bends and low-lying lands of the middle Yangtze.
simp_chinese: 石首位于江汉平原南缘的长江之滨。县名据说来自江边北山之首的一块孤石。明代石首属荆州府，坐落在长江中游河湾和低地之间。

english: Shisō lies in the mountains of northwestern Harima, where the Ibo River flows south from the ironmaking country. In the seventeenth century, merchants developed boat transport as far as Yamasaki, the district's castle town. Iron made in the northern mountains was gathered there and sent downstream to Aboshi. Furnace operators obtained access to forests managed by domains or the shogunate, using their iron sand and timber for the tatara works.
simp_chinese: 宍粟位于播磨西北部山地，揖保川从炼铁地区向南流去。十七世纪，商人开辟河运，使船只能够到达郡内城下町山崎。北部山地生产的铁汇集于此，再由船运送到下游的网干。炼铁经营者承包由诸藩或幕府管理的山林，利用砂铁和林木供应踏鞴炉。

english: Shitara lies in eastern Mikawa, where river valleys open between the mountains of central Japan. In 1575 Takeda Katsuyori besieged Nagashino Castle as he sought to advance west. Oda Nobunaga and Tokugawa Ieyasu brought an army to its relief, and the Takeda moved to meet them at Shitaragahara. Firearms played a prominent part in the battle; Katsuyori's army suffered heavy losses and withdrew, leaving the castle in Tokugawa hands.
simp_chinese: 设乐位于三河东部，河谷穿行于日本中部山地之间。1575年，武田胜赖为向西扩张而围攻长篠城。织田信长与德川家康率军来援，武田军遂转至设乐原迎战。火绳枪在战斗中发挥了重要作用；胜赖军损失惨重后撤退，长篠城仍由德川氏掌握。

english: Shiveh belongs to the mountain country west of the Panj, where streams descend from the Badakhshan heights. The Shewa River is one of the tributaries of the upper Panj, and the high Lake Shewa lies among the mountains at more than three thousand metres. Its cold basin and the valleys below form part of the rugged country between the Kokcha and the great bend of the Panj.
simp_chinese: 希韦位于喷赤河以西的山区，溪流从巴达赫尚高地流下。希韦河是喷赤河上游的支流之一，高山上的希韦湖则位于海拔三千多米处。寒冷的湖盆及其下方的河谷，属于科克恰河与喷赤河大转弯之间那片崎岖的山地。

english: Shiveluch rises west of this part of northern Kamchatka, beyond the Kumroch Range. The volcanic massif has an older edifice and a younger active cone; great eruptions have repeatedly reshaped its southern side. Rivers east of the mountains descend toward the Pacific coast.
simp_chinese: 希韦卢奇火山耸立在堪察加北部这一地区以西，位于库姆罗奇山脉的另一侧。火山体由较古老的山体和较年轻的活火山锥组成，历次大规模喷发不断改变其南坡；山脉以东的河流则流向太平洋海岸。

english: Shiwa lies in the upper Kitakami valley of northern Mutsu. Its medieval rulers, the Shiba family, held Kōsuiji Castle above the surrounding countryside. In 1588 Nanbu Nobunao attacked and captured the stronghold, bringing the district under Nanbu control. The castle was later renamed Kōriyama, and its position continued to command the route through the valley between the northern and southern parts of the Nanbu lands.
simp_chinese: 紫波位于陆奥北部的北上川上游河谷。中世统治此地的斯波氏据有高水寺城，俯瞰周围乡野。1588年，南部信直攻取这座城堡，紫波随之归南部氏控制。城堡后来改称郡山城，其位置继续控制着贯穿河谷、连接南部领地南北的道路。

english: Shìxī was a district in the mountain country west of the Lǐ River plain. The Yuan established Shìxī Zhou under Lǐzhōu, alongside neighbouring Cílì. Later local traditions connected the name with hereditary chiefs of the surrounding valleys, although the exact relationship between the Yuan zhou and later native offices was disputed by Qing gazetteer writers. Early in the Ming, imperial armies campaigned against Shìxī and other mountain communities as the dynasty consolidated its authority in the southwest.
simp_chinese: 柿溪位于澧水平原以西的山地。元代在此设柿溪州，与邻近慈利同属澧州路。后来的地方传统将柿溪与山谷间的世袭首领联系起来，但清代志书作者对元州与后世土司之间的关系有所争议。明初，朝廷军队在巩固西南统治时，对柿溪及其他山地社群用兵。

english: Shixing lies in the mountain valleys of northern Guangdong. Its Hakka communities built enclosed residences with thick walls, towers and interior courtyards, providing shelter for families and protection against attack. At Aizi south of the county seat, the Guan family began building the great Mantang enclosure in 1833. Its design brought several separate compounds together in one large fortified complex beside the meeting of two streams.
simp_chinese: 始兴位于广东北部的山间河谷。当地客家人建造围楼，以厚墙、角楼和院落为家族提供居所与防护。县城南面的隘子，官氏家族于1833年开始修建满堂围，将数座围屋组合成大型建筑群，坐落在两条溪流交汇之处。

english:
Shizhao was the county seat of Hezhou, set where the Jialing, Fu and Qu rivers meet in eastern Sichuan, a place that took its name from the joining of the waters. Hezhou had been a prefecture since the Western Wei in 556, and its seat controlled boat traffic from three river valleys. When the Mongols invaded Sichuan, the Southern Song moved both the county and the prefectural seats in 1243 to the fortified height of Diaoyu Mountain on the south bank of the Jialing.

The fortress held out through repeated assaults. The Mongol great khan Möngke died during the campaign in 1259, and the defenders, led in turn by Wang Jian and Zhang Jue, did not surrender until 1279. The defence stayed in local memory: in 1494 a shrine was built to honour Wang Jian and Zhang Jue, and in 1618 an inscribed stone arch was raised to the resistance of the fortress and its people. Under the Qing, Hezhou passed to Chongqing Prefecture in 1728.
simp_chinese:
石照是合州的附郭县，位于川东嘉陵江、涪江、渠江三江汇合之处，合州之名正由江水相合而来。合州自西魏556年起设州，州治控制着三条河谷的船运。蒙古军入蜀时，南宋于1243年把州治和县治迁到嘉陵江南岸的钓鱼山山城上。

山城经受了多次进攻。蒙古大汗蒙哥于1259年围攻期间死去，王坚、张珏先后守城，直到1279年才开城投降。战事结束许久后，这场防御仍为当地人所纪念：1494年，人们建祠祭祀王坚、张珏；1618年又立石坊，纪念山城军民的抵抗。清雍正六年（1728年），合州改隶重庆府。

english: Shīzhōu stood in the mountainous country of western Hubei, among the rivers and valleys of the Qīng River basin. The Ming established Shīzhōu Guard in 1371, giving its military officers authority over a network of hereditary native chiefships. These included Shīnán, Sànmáo and Zhōngjiàn, each with its own rulers and dependent offices. In 1735 the Qing replaced the chiefships with appointed administration and established Shīnán Prefecture at Ēnshī, bringing the old guard country into a new system of counties.
simp_chinese: 施州位于湖北西部山地，清江流域的河谷纵横其间。明洪武四年（1371年）设施州卫，统辖施南、散毛、忠建等众多世袭土司，各司又有自己的下属建置。清雍正十三年（1735年），朝廷推行改土归流，在恩设施南府，以新设州县取代这一地区原有的土司和军卫体系。

english:
Shizhu lies in the wooded mountains south of the Yangtze, a Tujia region governed for generations by hereditary chiefs. Its name is said to derive from two mountain passes, Shitong and Zhupu. Steep ridges gave local rulers places to build strongholds, while paths through the mountains linked the district with the river valleys beyond.

In the late Ming, the chieftain Qin Liangyu led troops from Shizhu in service of the dynasty. Her soldiers were known as the White Shaft troops, after the wood used for their spear shafts. They fought in several campaigns, including the struggle against the rebellion of She Chongming and An Bangyan. On Wanshou Mountain, Qin had fortified gates and strongholds built to shelter and defend her people.
simp_chinese:
石砫位于长江以南林木茂密的山区，是世代由土司治理的土家地区。据说地名取自石潼、砫蒲两关。陡峭山岭为当地统治者提供了修筑要塞的地点，山路则将此地与山外河谷相连。

明末，石砫土司秦良玉率兵为朝廷征战。她的部众因枪杆所用白蜡木而称白杆兵，参加过多次战役，包括平定奢崇明、安邦彦之乱。秦良玉又在万寿山修筑寨门和堡垒，供军民防守。

english: Shizilu takes its name from the crossing of two roads, one linking Linyi with the coast at Andongwei and the other running between Ju and Qingkou. In 1265 the Mongol commander Chongxi built walls here and stationed troops; his son Qingxu later took command of the post. The settlement was listed as a town of Juzhou in a Ming gazetteer, and an inspection office was established in the early Ming. Its walls were repaired during that dynasty.
simp_chinese: 十字路因两条道路交会而得名：一条连接临沂与海边的安东卫，另一条通往莒州和清口。1265年，蒙古将领重喜在此筑城驻兵，后来其子庆绪移镇守卫。明代方志将十字路列为莒州属镇，明初又设巡检司，城墙也曾在明代修葺。

english: Shizong lies among the hills of eastern Yunnan. Its name comes from the Shizong community, which held the Nilong basin before the Mongol conquest. The Yuan established Shizong as a prefecture in 1290, and under the Ming it belonged to Guangxi Prefecture. During the Chenghua reign an appointed magistrate replaced the hereditary prefect, though the local official remained as an assistant. In 1600 the seat was moved to Nilong, returning the administration to the basin associated with the old Shizong community.
simp_chinese: 师宗位于云南东部的丘陵之间，因蒙古征服以前据有匿弄甸的师宗部得名。1290年，元朝设师宗州，明代属广西府。成化年间，朝廷派流官知州，并将原来的土官改为同知。1600年，州治迁往匿弄甸，回到与古代师宗部相关的盆地。

english: Shizunai lies on Hokkaido's southern coast at the mouth of the Shizunai River. The Ainu settlement of Shibechari stood in its valley, where fortified sites known as chashi overlooked the river. Shakushain, a leader from Shibechari, became the central figure in a great uprising against the Matsumae domain. In 1669 he called on Ainu communities across Ezo to resist Japanese control and trading practices. Matsumae forces fought back, and Shakushain was killed at a peace feast in nearby Niikappu. The struggle ended with the domain gaining a stronger position over Ainu trade and labour.
simp_chinese: 静内位于北海道南岸静内川河口。河谷中的阿伊努聚落希贝查里周围有俯瞰河流的“查西”防御遗址；当地首领沙牟奢允后来成为反抗松前藩大起事的核心人物。1669年，他号召虾夷地各地阿伊努人抵抗日本人的统制与贸易方式。松前军反击，沙牟奢允在邻近新冠的和议宴上被杀。战后松前藩加强了对阿伊努贸易和劳役的控制。

english: Shkhancheriekhabl was a Circassian aul in the country south of the Kuban River, among the settlements of the Adyghe people. The lowlands here give way southward to the foothills of the Caucasus, while streams drain toward the Kuban. Its name preserves the Circassian element for a settlement or neighbourhood, found in many other aul names across this region. The surrounding land belonged to a world of villages and grazing grounds between the mountains and the river.
simp_chinese: 什汉切尔耶哈布勒是库班河以南的一处切尔克斯村落，位于阿迪格人的聚落地区。低地向南逐渐过渡为高加索山麓，溪流则流向库班河。地名保留了切尔克斯语中表示聚落或居民区的成分，这一成分也见于附近许多村名。山脉与河流之间的土地，分布着村庄与牧场。

english:
Shkodër stands by the lake that bears its name, where the Buna, Drin and Kir rivers meet beneath the mountains of northern Albania. Ancient Scodra was a capital of the Illyrian kingdom until the Romans defeated King Gentius in 168 BC. Its great hilltop fortress, Rozafa, overlooks the waters and the approaches from the Adriatic. In the Middle Ages the city passed between Balkan rulers before becoming a Venetian possession.

The Balšić lords handed Shkodër to Venice in 1396. In 1478 Sultan Mehmed II surrounded the city and bombarded its fortress with heavy cannon, but the defenders held out. A Venetian–Ottoman agreement in 1479 ended the siege and ceded the city to the Ottomans; those who wished to leave could depart. Shkodër became the seat of an Ottoman sanjak and a centre of northern Albanian commerce, with craftsmen working in cloth, silk, arms and silver. From 1757 to 1831 the powerful Bushati family ruled a pashalik centred on the city.
simp_chinese:
斯库台位于同名湖畔，布纳河、德林河与基尔河在阿尔巴尼亚北部群山脚下汇合。古代的斯科德拉曾是伊利里亚王国的首都，直到公元前168年罗马人击败国王根提乌斯。雄踞山顶的罗扎法城堡俯瞰河湖水域和来自亚得里亚海方向的道路。中世纪时，城市先后归属巴尔干各地统治者，后来成为威尼斯的领地。

巴尔希奇领主于1396年将斯库台交给威尼斯。1478年，苏丹穆罕默德二世包围城市，以重炮轰击要塞，守军却坚持了下来。1479年威尼斯与奥斯曼人达成协议，结束围城并将城市割让给后者；愿意离去的居民获准撤出。斯库台成为奥斯曼桑贾克的治所和阿尔巴尼亚北部的商业中心，工匠制作布匹、丝织品、武器与银器。1757年至1831年，强大的布沙提家族统治着以此为中心的帕夏领地。

english: Along the southern Oregon coast, rivers descend from wooded mountains to meet the Pacific. Tututni-speaking peoples lived along this shore and beside rivers including the Rogue, Pistol, and Sixes. Their villages drew on both forest and sea, and canoes served different waters: high-prowed vessels carried travelers on the ocean, while shovel-nosed canoes were suited to shallower rivers.
simp_chinese: 在俄勒冈南部海岸，河流从森林覆盖的山地奔向太平洋。说图图特尼语的各族人居住在这片海岸，以及罗格河、皮斯托尔河和西克西斯河等河流沿岸。村落从森林和海洋取得生活所需，而不同的水域也有不同的舟船：高船首的独木舟用于海上航行，铲形船首的独木舟则适合浅水河道。

english: Sho, also known as Shobando, was a stopping place on the road across eastern Tibet. Its position at a difficult junction of routes made it a significant station for travellers moving between Sichuan and the Tibetan interior. An old defensive wall follows the mountain above the settlement, recalling the power of local chiefs and the need to protect the approaches through the valleys. According to local accounts, the wall was built in the early seventeenth century under the chief Langga Zhaxi, during a period of unrest. Constructed of earth and stone and equipped with watchtowers, it guarded the chief's lands against attack from beyond the mountains.
simp_chinese: 硕督又称硕般多，是横穿藏东道路上的一处驿站。它位于险要岔路，成为往来四川与藏地腹地旅人的重要落脚处。聚落上方山坡有旧城墙，留下地方首领保护山谷通道的痕迹。据当地记载，十七世纪初局势动荡，部落首领朗加扎西主持修筑城墙。墙体以土石筑成，设有烽火台，用以守卫领地，抵御来自山外的袭击。

english: The Shohopanaiti were one of the groups of the Bannock people, also known as the Cottonwood Bannock. The Bannock homeland lay in the Snake River country and neighbouring mountains, where families hunted, fished and gathered plants in different seasons. Horses brought new possibilities for travel, and from the eighteenth century mounted Bannock and Shoshone groups journeyed together. Their routes linked the river plains with the mountains and the bison country farther east.
simp_chinese: 肖霍帕奈提是班诺克人的一个群体，也称“杨树班诺克”。班诺克人的故土位于蛇河地区及邻近山地，家庭随季节狩猎、捕鱼和采集植物。马匹带来了新的旅行可能；从十八世纪起，骑马的班诺克人与肖肖尼人经常一起出行。他们的道路把河流平原与群山以及更东面的野牛猎场联系起来。

english: Shoindykol is a seasonal lake in the steppe northeast of Arkalyk. It belongs to a small group of neighbouring lakes that includes Zharkol, Sabyndy and Taldy. Channels that can dry out seasonally connect Shoindykol with nearby Zharkol. Together these shallow waters interrupt the open grassland and provide resting places for birds crossing the interior of Kazakhstan.
simp_chinese: 绍因德科尔是阿尔卡雷克东北方草原上的季节性湖泊。它与扎尔科尔、萨宾德和塔尔德等邻近湖泊组成小型湖群，季节性干涸的水道将它与扎尔科尔相连。这些浅水湖打破了开阔草原的连续景观，也为穿越哈萨克内陆的鸟类提供歇息之处。

english: Sholakkorgan stood on a caravan road along the northern slopes of the Karatau Mountains. Its medieval enclosure covered a raised, roughly rectangular site about 160 by 180 metres across. Parts of the defensive walls survive along its edges. The settlement is dated to the thirteenth through fifteenth centuries, when a chain of towns and fortifications lined this route beneath the mountains.
simp_chinese: 绍拉克科尔甘位于卡拉套山北坡的商队道路上。中世纪的设防聚落坐落在高处，范围近似长方形，约长160米、宽180米，边缘仍留有部分防御墙。遗址年代为十三至十五世纪，当时山麓沿路分布着一系列城镇与堡垒。

english:
Sholhapur, now commonly called Solapur, lies on the Deccan plateau in Maharashtra. Inscriptions found at its fort preserve older names for the town, including Sonalpur and Sandalpur. The fort became a point of rivalry between the neighbouring sultanates of Bijapur and Ahmadnagar.

The rulers of Bijapur and Ahmadnagar met at the fort to make peace in the 1520s. The fort continued to figure in their disputes and later passed through other Deccan powers.
simp_chinese:
绍拉布尔今通常称索拉普尔，位于马哈拉施特拉的德干高原。堡内铭文保存了城镇的旧名，包括索纳尔普尔和桑达尔普尔。堡垒后来成为邻近的比贾普尔与艾哈迈德讷格尔苏丹国争夺的据点。

比贾普尔与艾哈迈德讷格尔两国统治者曾于1520年代在堡中会面议和。此后堡垒仍卷入双方争端，又先后转入其他德干政权之手。

english: Shoma belongs to the country of the Tonga, on the plateau north of the Zambezi. Tonga communities occupied both the uplands and the valleys leading down to the river, with authority expressed through local leaders and ritual specialists. A chief named Shoma was remembered in accounts of a village in this region, among a wider landscape of settlements and grazing country.
simp_chinese: 绍马位于赞比西河以北的高原，是汤加人的土地。汤加社群居住在高地及通往河流的谷地，地方领袖和仪式主持者各自拥有权威。记载中提到这一地区有一处由绍马首领统领的村落，周围分布着其他聚落和牧地。

english: Shopando, also called Shodu, was a stopping place on the route through eastern Tibet. Its position at a difficult mountain junction made it a useful station on the road between Sichuan and the Tibetan interior. An old wall follows the hillside above the settlement. Local accounts attribute its construction in the early seventeenth century to the chief Langga Zhaxi, who sought to defend his land against attack.
simp_chinese: 硕板多又称硕督，是藏东道路上的一处驿站。它位于险要山间岔路，为往来四川与藏地腹地的旅人提供落脚处。聚落上方山坡有旧城墙；据当地记载，十七世纪初部落首领朗加扎西主持修筑城墙，以保卫领地免受袭击。

english: Shoptikol is named for a lake in the open steppe country of northern Kazakhstan.
